messages:
elena (runtime): Quick recap from the 2-week perf sprint — TL;DR: p95 latency down ~22%, token cost down ~18% on our standard chat workload. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/perf/sprint-17 :tada:

sam (ml infra): Huge win. Main contributors were the new microbatcher + hot-prefix caching tweak. Also the compact-kernel switch helped tail latency on long seqs.

jenna (observability): Canary graphs posted. Key numbers: p50 -12%, p95 -22%, p99 -9%, cost/unit -18%. I pinned the summary in #eng-runtime-canaries.

david (infra): We saw a 7% reduction in GPU utilization variance, which made autoscaler happier. No weird OOMs during canary.

rachel (product): Nice. Any change that affects SLAs for Dedicated customers? Need to update release notes if so.

elena (runtime): No SLA-impacting changes. It's opt-in via rollout flag for now. We'll flip default after one more week of canary.

marc (sre): Noted. Keep alert thresholds stable. If we flip default we should watch the error budget burn for 24h.

sam (ml infra): Quick technical summary: 
```
- Microbatcher v2: sequence-aware coalescing, reduced mutex contention.
- Hot-prefix cache: more aggressive TTL for short prefixes, avoids cold KV lookups.
- Compact kernels: float16 fast path for attn on seq>1024.
```

elena (runtime): We also added a safety rollback: if p99 latency degrades >5% in a region, requests automatically route to previous model variant for that customer tier. 

jenna (observability): Action item: add a dashboard tile for rollback triggers (created ticket #PERF-418).

sam (ml infra): Bench numbers on my laptop (local repro) for the standard chat microbenchmark: 
- baseline: 63 ms p95, 0.96 token-$
- new: 49 ms p95, 0.79 token-$
Numbers are stable across seeds.

elena (runtime): Thanks Sam. Ops plan: keep canary at 10% traffic / region for 48h, then 50% for 12h, then flip if stable.

david (infra): I'll coordinate capacity reservations for the 50% step. Also will pre-warm caches in the cluster to reduce initial spike.

rachel (product): I'll draft a customer-facing blurb and a short internal note for Sales. Want to align on the expected cost savings messaging.

marc (sre): One heads-up: telemetry shows increased small-LRU evictions in one cluster. Probably fine, but let's watch the miss-rate.

elena (runtime): Filed #RUNTIME-992 for the eviction tuning work. We'll prioritize if miss-rate > 5% during canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for canary-tag: microbatcher-v2-hotprefix-compactkernels at 2026-03-23T10:12:40Z

jenna (observability): Posted follow-up benchmarks and raw logs to the thread. If you want to dig into flamegraphs, ping me.

sam (ml infra): Next steps: iterate quantization profile for seq<128 to push cost down another 5%. I can prototype next week.

elena (runtime): Great. Closing note: big kudos to everyone — please add any regressions to this thread. If you don't see the canary metrics in your region within 30m, flag it here. :shipit:
